item.title: IRON MAIDEN Fans Slam 50th Anniversary Tour: 'Most Predictable Setlist Possible'
item.description: Iron Maiden launched their Run for Your Lives 50th anniversary tour on May 27 in Budapest, Hungary. Grab Your Tickets Here. The show introduced Simon Dawson behind the drums, stepping in after Nicko McBrain retired in late 2024.

item.title: Jethro Tull’s Ian Anderson Slams Brazilian Fans & iPhones: "Crowds Are Worse Than Ever"
item.description: So Ian Anderson, flute-wielding sorcerer of JETHRO TULL, has had it with you people—yes, YOU, the one recording an entire concert through a cracked iPhone 8 with 2% battery while also screaming “PLAY THICK AS A BRICK!

item.title: Slipknot's New 'S' Logo Sparks Outrage Among Fans
item.description: Slipknot has rolled out a batch of limited edition merchandise, and one particular shirt seems to have set off quite the tempest. On the front? The band’s name—classic enough.

item.title: Jaime Bennington, Chester Bennington's Son Calls Out Linkin Park
item.description: Linkin Park thought they were shaking things up by naming Emily Armstrong their new vocalist, but it’s more like they kicked a hornet’s nest while blindfolded. Fans aren’t just upset—they’re seething.

item.title: AS I LAY DYING's Tim Lambesis on New Album: “As Passionate as Ever”
item.description: Tim Lambesis, the ever-controversial voice behind AS I LAY DYING, let slip in a recent chat with the Today’s Boondoggle podcast that the band’s next studio album is set to land later this year (2024).
